citations.claim: first violation: body overlaps wall 0 by 0.349 at step 4, centre x=6.65 inside penetration zone of wall face at x=6.5
one step earlier body was approaching from the right at x=7.29 with -37 m/s, so step 3->4 is the impact step that bounces but leaves penetration

counterfactual.change: Same 4-step scenario with only dt reduced from 0.02068 to 0.001; high speed is then resolved with fine substeps and no wall overlap occurs.

explanation: Fast body (vx=-37.14 m/s) hits the +x face of wall 0 (face at x=6.5) between steps 3 and 4. Per-step travel ~0.77 m exceeds radius 0.5 despite 26 substeps. Velocity correctly reverses (vx=+37.14 at step 4) but positional correction fails to expel the body, leaving centre at x=6.65, i.e. 0.349 penetration beyond surface, exceeding 0.15 limit. Reducing dt alone removes the failure, pointing to inadequate impulse/positional-correction resolution at large dt*velocity.
vision_note: The red ball moves left toward the right edge of the dark wall over steps 1 to 3. In step 4 it ends up half-embedded in the wall edge rather than rebounding clear.
